status: PROVISIONAL: every value here is undecided by the owner and may change; the pool's params_hash is the sha256 of this file

capture.rule: for each province a nation holds at the end whose keep was captured during the season: the owner of the donor host that became the garrison at its LAST capture
capture.antiInflation: end state only: one line per province, the last capture; a keep lost again or retaken later earns nothing for the earlier capture

reinforcement.rule: troops of a member's hosts standing on the keep tile of a keep its nation holds when the season has ended (the supplier is the host's owner, whoever's nation holds the keep)
reinforcement.antiInflation: net end state: every host is read once from the final Province account; splitting, or moving troops in and out, cannot raise the total; the capture's donor host goes home and is not counted twice

defence.rule: one credit per repelled contest to the members whose hosts stood on the keep
defence.notDerivable: the chain's record of a repelled contest (CONQUEST event KEEP_BROKEN) names the contending nation and the progress only; the host ids standing on the keep tile at that bell are in no log record
defence.missingRecord: a list of defending host ids (or holdings) in the CONQUEST record of the bell a contest breaks

resourceSupply.notDerivable: no resource transfer instruction exists in the game
resourceSupply.missingRecord: a transfer instruction and its log record

decided.entryFee: a pool parameter; 25 test USDC (25,000,000 base units of the 6-decimal test mint) in this demo
decided.split: 80% of every fee to the prize pool, 20% to the operator
decided.winner: the nation holding the most provinces (keeps) when the season has ended, counted on chain from the game's Province accounts
decided.eligibility: operator-run AI citizens are not prize-eligible; a claim needs a paid Entry

provisionalRules: tie for first place: more territory bells wins; still tied: the tied nations share the prize equally
all contributions zero: every paid member of the winning nation gets one point (equal split)
no eligible member in the winning nation: every payer takes its part of the prize back (refund)
shares are posted by the operator as a merkle root over a publicly recomputable ledger
